prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Draw a production transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 complete GROUP sprites. Each group is the same existing adult man with his tawny capybara companion from the two references. Preserve olive broad face, swept salt-and-pepper hair, full white beard, black T-shirt with tiny chest mark, navy shorts, black trainers/watch, teal capybara harness and burgundy leash, illustrated pixel-painted shading, plum outlines. IMPORTANT ANATOMY: man has exactly TWO ARMS and TWO HANDS in every sprite. His RIGHT HAND holds ONE clear glass of amber beer with small white foam, at waist/chest height. His LEFT HAND holds the leash. NEVER ADD AN EXTRA ARM OR HAND TO HOLD THE LEASH. In REAR views show left arm/hand at LEFT side of body holding leash, right bent arm/hand at RIGHT side holding glass. Leash may cross behind body to capybara at right. In FRONT views man's right beer-hand is at IMAGE LEFT, his left leash-hand at IMAGE RIGHT. Keep these two occupied hands steady while walking; no other hand swings.
ROW 1 four side-profile RIGHT walking phases: left stride, passing feet under hips, right stride, opposite passing. Man carries beer upright; capybara walks quadruped beside him.
ROW 2 four FRONT walks toward viewer, alternating gait phases.
ROW 3 four REAR walks away, alternating gait phases, no faces; exactly TWO arms, right arm with beer, left arm with leash.
ROW 4: cell1 man SEATED RIGHT, beer lowered near knee, capybara on ground beside him; cell2 man SEATED RIGHT sipping glass at mouth, animal beside; cell3 man STANDING STILL three-quarter FRONT RIGHT with beer low and animal beside; cell4 man STANDING STILL REAR with both feet flat and animal on ground beside, right hand beer left hand leash, no gait.
Seated man has truly bent hips/knees, horizontal thighs and lower legs down, invisible stool posture; seated naturally shorter at same body scale, no chair drawn. Animal never holds props. EXACT 16 groups, complete heads/shoes/paws/glasses/leashes inside cells with generous transparent outer margins and gutters, no cropped limbs, no overlaps. Genuine alpha transparency, no background, floor, shadow, furniture, checkerboard, labels or text. Same identity/clothing/body proportions in every frame.
notes: Second generation corrected extra leash arm in rear walks. Selected source has exactly two man arms; capybara turns sideways in standing rear-watch group while man faces rear.
